title: Five Ways to Build a Growth Mindset
subtitle: Embrace challenges · learn from feedback · focus on effort · see failure as a lesson · celebrate progress

blocks.text: The practice sheet for the invitation to learn. Five moves stated without ornament: step outside the comfort zone; treat feedback as information rather than criticism; let effort drive progress; read failure as part of the journey; recognise distance travelled.

blocks.alt: Five Ways to Build a Growth Mindset
blocks.caption: Five Ways to Build a Growth Mindset — Embrace challenges · learn from feedback · focus on effort · see failure as a lesson · celebrate progress
blocks.explanation: The second entry is the corpus's own methodology in everyday register. "Feedback isn't criticism — it's information" is the same proposition the constitutional instruments make when they hold that dissent is not derogation and correction is not an attack on the corrected. The plates that state this in Latin and the plate that states it on a green banner are making one claim at two levels of formality.
